name: Irie Kenji
source:
Hiro's father and a Film Producer.

Several years ago, Kenji wanted to have a romantic life with Kayoko. Therefore, after they had worked together, he married her, and eventually had a child. However, because he was dissatisfied with Kayoko’s obsession with her work, the two of them always got in arguments. Afterwards, he had an affair and they ultimately divorced. 

[spoiler]One year later, he lived with Reika’s mother. Since his marriage had failed, he excluded and felt disappointed in his son, Hiro, especially after he found that his son had had an improper relationship with his adopted daughter Reika. Kenji thought that this was Kayoko’s way of getting her revenge after the breakup of their marriage.[/spoiler]


(Description from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1185680/White_Wings]Steam[/url])
